title: lathyrus nigricans
intro: Lathyrus nigricans, commonly known as the Black Pea Vetch or Black Pea, is a perennial legume plant native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cardiovascular diseases and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus nigricans are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
